# Facts.net

> > A comprehensive knowledge resource delivering curated facts across history, science, nature, sports, and celebrity biographies.

Facts.net provides in-depth articles spanning American history (Civil War, Revolutionary War), natural sciences (animals, astronomy), sports trivia (MLB, Olympics), and entertainment biographies. The site serves as an educational platform covering topics from extinct species and prehistoric creatures to presidential history and athletic achievements.

## Key Topics

- American History
- Celebrity Biographies
- Animal Facts & Endangered Species
- Sports History & Records
- Major League Baseball
- Natural Sciences
- Presidential History
- Entertainment Industry
- Wildlife Conservation
- Astronomy & Space
- Military History
- Television & Film Careers
- Athletic Performance
- Extinct Species
- Global Geography

## Popular General Knowledge

- [300 Crazy Fun Facts To Start Your Day](https://facts.net/fun-facts): Random trivia collection covering global facts and general knowledge

## American History

- [Top 20 Civil War Facts - History, Effects, Battles & More](https://facts.net/civil-war-facts): American Civil War battles, Union vs Confederate, and Robert E. Lee
- [Revolutionary War Facts: Causes, Battles & More](https://facts.net/revolutionary-war-facts): American War of Independence: Lexington, Concord, and colonial battles
- [Zachary Taylor Facts: Ancestry, Presidency & More](https://facts.net/zachary-taylor-facts): 12th President Zachary Taylor: Whig Party, Mexican War military hero

- [100 Fascinating Running Facts You Should Not Miss](https://facts.net/running-facts): Running statistics, marathon records, and athletic performance insights

## Animals & Wildlife

- [40 Tyrannosaurus Rex Facts About the Greatest Predator in History](https://facts.net/tyrannosaurus-rex-facts): T-Rex anatomy, paleontology discoveries, and prehistoric predator facts
- [50 Giant Panda Facts That You Never Knew About](https://facts.net/panda-facts): Giant panda biology, China habitat, bamboo diet, and conservation
- [Blobfish Facts: Appearance, Diet, Predators & More](https://facts.net/blobfish-facts): Deep-sea blobfish (Psychrolutes marcidus) biology and endangered status
- [Dodo Bird Facts: Habitat, Diet, Extinction & More](https://facts.net/dodo-bird-facts): Extinct dodo bird (Raphus cucullatus) from Mauritius habitat and diet
- [40 Interesting Pug Facts You Probably Never Knew About](https://facts.net/pug-facts): Pug breed history: Queen Victoria, House of Orange, and characteristics

## Science & Nature

- [Planet Mercury Facts: Location, Size, Orbit & More](https://facts.net/mercury-facts): Mercury planet astronomy: solar system location and orbital properties
